title: ExitPlanMode Metadata — Tier 2 (Partial)
description: Partial metadata for the ExitPlanMode tool. Signals the end of a planning phase and user approval. decision.signal_type='post_decision' — the user approved the plan. koth.outcome_signal='win' when the plan is approved and proceeds to implementation.

notes.decision.signal_type: 'post_decision' — user approved the plan, transitioning from planning to implementation.
notes.koth.outcome_signal: 'win' = plan approved and implemented, 'loss' = plan rejected or user cancelled.
notes.decision.decision_id: Should match the decision_id set on the paired EnterPlanMode call for full lifecycle tracing.
